headline: India Considers Paring Stakes in Four State-Owned Banks to 75%
summary: The Indian government is considering reducing its stake in four public sector banks to 75% to meet minimum public shareholding norms.
why: State divestments in public sector banks help comply with stock market regulations and can facilitate further sector consolidation.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Increased public float and potential consolidation improve market liquidity and efficiency for public sector lenders.

why_moved: Plans for stake sales in public sector banks boost equity float expectations and investor interest in the banking sector.
